title: Imported fbx skeleton only animations as animation library look wrong, when compared to how they look other 3D Software (most likely wrong translations).
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: Godot 4.5.1


### System information

Godot v4.5.1.stable - Windows 11 (build 22631) - Single-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.7714) - AMD Ryzen 7 8845HS w/ Radeon 780M Graphics (16 threads) - 63.30 GiB memory

### Issue description

Basically, i have a couple of animations from from 

https://www.explosive.ws/products/rpg-character-mecanim-animation-pack

and importing them as skeletons yields very wrong results.
First half of the video you see how the animation should look like, the latter half is how it looks at in godot 4.5.1

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/07b2ec6c-8dfe-4492-9b2c-f5e2c9bcf2b8


I also created proper bone maps for the character, and the animations libraries too.
I tried multiple settings, importing by ufbx, or fbx2gltf, but, they all yielded the same result.
I also tried setting a default TPose but it also didn't make any difference.

### Steps to reproduce

- simply extract the sample project.
- hit play
- alternatively you can play it in the editor by setting the "current" animation.


### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)


[broken-animation.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/23423017/broken-animation.zip)
